_comment: ECUMaster CAN Switch Board V3 (CSB3) frames on the shared 1 Mbit/s CAN1 bus. Split out of link_g4x_can_setup.json (decision D1, 2026-10-02): that file stays the ECU broadcast contract; this one holds the switchboard's own frames. Layout source: ECUMaster CAN Switch Board V3 manual v2.1 (FW 3.0+), sections 5-6; mirrored in CAN-BUS-ID-ALLOCATION-TABLE.md section 5 and bench/frames.py. Scale/offset here use the DECODE convention (value = raw * scale + offset), like the .lcs, the ID table and frames.py. The cluster does not decode any of these frames; RealDash does not read them. bench/check_parity.py checks this file against frames.py and the ID table.
manual: CAN Switch Board V3 user manual, document v2.1, firmware 3.0 or later (03 Dec 2024)
cycle_wording: 0x640-0x642: periodic, switchboard 'CAN send rate' (default 20 Hz = 50 ms). 0x643: periodic 50 ms PCLink CAN TX stream from the ECU; the bytes only change when the ECU changes an output. The manual sets no required rate for 0x643.

ecu_receive._comment: What the ECU takes from the switchboard frames (Daniel 2026-10-14, DECISIONS R80: CAN config is written here now, not parked for setup). Mirrored as Direction="Receive" channels 0x640 / 0x642 in link_g4x_can_setup.lcs; bench/check_parity.py checks the .lcs against this block and the SW_MASK bits above. Bit numbering: bit N of byte B = .lcs StartBit B*8+N (bit 0 = LSB). Switchboard frames go to the ECU only (R51); the ECU echoes what displays need (reverse -> 0x3EB Gear Position = 7, comm fault -> 0x3F1 byte 6 bit 5).

channels.name: Cruise Stalk mV
channels.pclink_target: CAN voltage channel, decoded by math channels into SET/COAST, RES/ACC, CANCEL (ECUMASTER_SWITCHBOARD_SETUP.md Step 4.1)

channels.name: Clutch Switch
channels.use: cruise cancel; clutch switch for flat shift / launch

channels.name: Reverse Switch
channels.use: gear = R: drives 0x3EB Gear Position = 7 (cluster R display, RealDash reverse camera)

channels.name: Analog Input 1
channels.assignment: Unassigned (was cabin temp; A/C belongs to the OEM amplifier, 2026-09-27)

channels.name: Analog Input 2
channels.assignment: OEM cruise stalk resistor ladder, C14 pin 5 (RES/ACC ~68, SET/COAST ~198, CANCEL ~418 ohm; ECUMASTER_SWITCHBOARD_SETUP.md Step 4.1)

frames.name: Rotary / Switch / Analog State / Low-Side State / Heartbeat

bits.3: Switch 4 - unassigned (was cruise SET; no such stalk wire)
bits.4: Switch 5 - unassigned (was cruise RESUME; no such stalk wire)
bits.5: Switch 6 - clutch pedal down (C17 cruise clutch switch pin 2, ground-active; FL_CLUTCH_SW_C1)
bits.6: Switch 7 - brake pedal pressed (S9 pin 1 +12V -> opto IN1 -> S7; FL_BRAKE_SW_C1, R56)
bits.7: Switch 8 - reverse engaged (back-up switch B1 pin 1 +12V -> opto IN2 -> S8; R56)

channels.name: AS_MASK
channels.note: bit N = Analog State N+1 (per manual: 0 below 2 V, 1 above 3 V)

channels.name: LS_MASK
channels.note: bits 0-3 = state of low-side outputs L1-L4

frames.name: Low-Side Output Control
frames._comment: Source = ECU (PCLink CAN TX stream), decided 2026-06-14. The cluster never transmits 0x643. L4 is the oil warning LED (Dan 2026-10-26); L1-L3 unused. Manual: DLC >= 4, byte N = L(N+1) ctrl, bytes 4-7 = 0.

channels.name: L4 ctrl
channels.assignment: oil warning LED (CSB3 cavity 26, w_oil_k / D-OIL)
